correctness.rationale: The invertible-coordinate locus of e3(z)=0 is isomorphic, via four coordinate reciprocals, to the complement of the four coordinate and three partition lines on the trace-zero plane. Its six triple and three double geometric intersections are S4-equivariant. Normalization and branch correction yield q^2+(1-v-m)q+1-v-2m+b+m(m-1), giving every field form by the five S4 conjugacy classes and every extension via sigma^n. Independently recomputed all 24 permutations, incidence coefficients, the split q=3,5,7 counts and the zeta periodicity; these are checks on the full geometric proof, not an extrapolation.
residual_risks: The geometric projective-model and line exhaustion apply in odd characteristic; in characteristic 2 the seven-line arrangement changes.
The count for non-split cases relies on the S4 descent and fixed-incidence data, not a direct enumeration in every extension.
